question: Can 32 paid interventions identify unseen effects in a declared causal composition class, as measured by a complete source-grammar oracle? Separate information limits from learned-representation failure.
context: WSP134 source-safe unfamiliar 400/1024 confidently wrong, WSP133 within-supplied grammar correct; WSP80 and NKR15 already research contradiction repair and abstention. No duplicate direct-learner implementation.

public_source.denied_seeds: all other seeds including 178800..178863,179800..179831,180000..180063 and existing WSP original/protected cohorts; deny before RNG
public_source.source_namespace: WSP135|KNOWN|seed or WSP135|UNFAMILIAR|seed hashed with SHA256 for source-only deterministic hidden wiring
public_source.known_law: Random permutation of six inputs; hidden gate1 AND/OR/XOR/XNOR of p0,p1; gate2 same of p2,p3; hidden third AND/OR/XOR/XNOR of gate1,gate2; XOR either p4 or p4 AND p5 (source-only parity condition).
public_source.unfamiliar_law: Random permutation; hidden gate1 and gate2 as above; source-only MAJORITY(gate1,gate2,p4) XOR p5.
public_source.visibility: All candidate public action x in 0..63 and its opaque ID are known to policy BEFORE choice; effect returned only AFTER one source-charged action. Hidden true circuit/condition/truth never provided to policy, except oracle's general class grammar.

arms.adaptive: Fully class-informed exact version-space oracle maximizes minority/majority split of candidate predicted effects over unqueried actions; tie lowest x.
arms.fixed: Same full grammar oracle, deterministic fixed x=0..31 at 32 queries.
arms.random: Same full grammar oracle, deterministic independent SHA256-seeded sample of 32 unique public x.
arms.source_membership: Source-only check true law occurs in oracle truth-table universe. Oracle must not get hidden per-world parameters.

decisions.information_sufficiency: Adaptive oracle uniquely predicts >=95% held effects in BOTH cohorts, zero confidently wrong; otherwise UNDERIDENTIFIED_WITH_GIVEN_GRAMMAR.
decisions.active_policy_gain: Adaptive oracle held correct minus max(fixed,random) held correct >=5 percentage points in unfamiliar cohort; report independently PASS/FAIL.
decisions.classification: This is identifiability upper bound WITH SOURCE GRAMMAR SUPPLIED to oracle, NOT native learning, unsupplied operators, or SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
report: held correct/wrong/abstain by arm and cohort
